description: arXiv:2608.23658v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: An LLM serving engine sizes its key-value (KV) cache once, at startup, permanently setting aside a reserve for the worst-case prefill activation. During decode-dominant phases that reserve sits idle, yet it cannot be handed to the KV pool because it is exactly the memory a large prefill needs.
